text:
Alyssa: Quick kickoff for PineGate private deploy preflight. Can we confirm network peer, KMS key type, audit-log forwarding endpoint, and any renewal risk here? Renewal coming up in ~22 days so want to log blockers.

Omar: Peering is provisioned from our side, handshake succeeded. One thing: their NAT gateway is SNATting internal traff to 10.50.0.0/16 which breaks our management path. Need a route exception.

Omar: Snippet they should add on their cloud VPC (example):
```
# allow management CIDR to reach inference nodes
route add -net 10.40.0.0/16 gw 10.50.1.1
# or in cloud console: add route 10.40.0.0/16 -> tgt: pinegate-mgmt-vpn
```

Kai: KMS note: they asked for an HSM-backed key (CloudKMS with HSM). Rotation window overlaps with their monthly maintenance (first Sunday). Recommend disabling automatic rotation until after final cutover, otherwise we risk transient decryption failures for cached tokens.

Kai: Minimal policy we need (IAM):
```
- principals: redwood-inference-service-account
- roles: cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
- conditions: request.origin == "pinegate-vpc"
```

Mike: Audit log forwarding: their SIEM endpoint drops connections if TLS ciphers include TLS1.0. We tested and got intermittent 504s. Recommend TLS1.2+ and keepalive 30s. Also set batch size to 500 events to avoid bursts that spike CPU on the collector.

Mike: Example curl to validate endpoint:
```
curl -v --tlsv1.2 --header "Content-Type: application/json" --data @sample.json https://logs.pinegate-siem.example/ingest
```

Alyssa: Good catches. Two operational questions: 1) Are there any firewall rules we need from our end? 2) Can we get their KMS key resource name so we can add the service account now?

Omar: From infra: open outbound 443 to logs endpoint, inbound 2200 from their bastion for support, and TCP 1024-65535 ephemeral from our backend for KV cache streaming. I'll post the exact rule set in a minute.

Omar: FW rules (summary):
- allow out tcp:443 -> logs.pinegate-siem (TLS)
- allow in tcp:2200 from pinegate-bastion
- allow established ephemeral for kv sync (tcp 1024-65535)

Kai: They gave a KMS key ARN: projects/pinegate/locations/global/keyRings/pg-kr/cryptoKeys/pg-llm-key. Add redwood-inference SA now. Also customer asked: do we support HSM-derived attestation? Short answer: yes, but need to complete paperwork for key escrow options.

InfraBot: Ticket CS-4821 created: "PineGate preflight - networking/KMS/audit checks" assigned to Omar, Kai. SLA: 48h.

Alyssa: Renewal risk: usage is low for last 30 days and seats are under-committed. I recommend AE run a health review and offer a 30-day extension on Dedicated capacity trial if we hit cutover milestones. Any objections? :thinking_face:

Omar: No objections. I'll flag to AE (cc @account-exec) and propose a joint demo during cutover dry-run.

Mike: From ops: add a one-week post-cutover check on audit logs and token refresh failures to the runbook. We had a rare replay bug in another account where KV sync retries escalated costs.

Alyssa: Action items captured: 1) Omar: send exact FW rules and confirm SNAT exception (due EOD). 2) Kai: add SA to KMS and confirm rotation policy (due tomorrow). 3) Mike: smoke test TLS handshake to SIEM and share curl report (due EOD). 4) AE to schedule health review + renewal discussion (in flight).

Kai: Quick question for Alyssa — will customer accept our managed key fallback if HSM attestation paperwork stalls?

Alyssa: They said prefer HSM but will accept managed KMS for the cutover if we document rollback and rekey path. I'll capture that as a conditional in the runbook.

Omar: Posting supporting links: runbook draft https://redwood-internal/runbooks/pinegate-preflight (internal), KMS onboarding checklist https://redwood-internal/docs/kms-onboard.

Alyssa: Thanks team. I'll convert these notes into the runbook checklist and follow up after the AE sync. :thumbsup:
